extracted.name: Make-Ahead Garlic Toast
extracted.description: Homemade garlic toast straight from your freezer! Slices of Italian bread spread with Parmesan garlic butter are frozen until you're ready to eat them.
instruction_lines: Mix butter, Parmesan, parsley, and garlic powder together in a bowl until well combined.

Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet; spread with seasoned butter. Place the baking sheet in the freezer until bread is frozen solid, about 1 hour. Transfer bread to a resealable plastic freezer bag and store in the freezer until needed.
